items.name: Hellish Weapons
entries: The demon's weapon attacks are magical and deal an extra 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage on a hit (included in the attacks).

items.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage.

items.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) necrotic damage.
